items.summary: Recommendation: retain containment-only execution and reject all new product, scheduler, AI-cost, and Site Factory admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 108 approved proposals lacking execution, 21 failed requests, 7 repair follow-ups, and 54 improvements awaiting measurement. Financially, the only supported revenue evidence is Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; named site rows show $0 attributable commission. September AI usage is 5,509 calls costing $996.71149775, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, CAC, payback, revenue forecast, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue and AI cost cover different periods, analytics has 0 configured sites out of 38 expected, and no infrastructure, domain, hosting, marketing, labor, or other cost ledger is supplied. Do not treat clicks, orders, impressions, sessions, conversions, AI calls, or social counts as revenue or margin. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after CTO releases a slot; require 2026-09-21-aligned site-attributed commission and direct-cost evidence before judging it financially.

Release one delivery slot only by completing or closing the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with dated root-cause or closure evidence, isolated validation, rollback point, and release boundary by 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z. Do not admit duplicate finance, AI-cost, scheduler, or control-plane work. After release, the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement may proceed with its current baseline and rollback path.

Minimum measurement required before any contribution-margin or cost-to-learn claim: a common reporting window linking site/content identifiers to recognized commission income, ordered and shipped status, affiliate clicks, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting, domain, marketing, and labor or agency cost. Existing telemetry is insufficient: Amazon revenue is one day old relative to the September AI-cost window, aggregate commission is not site-attributed, analytics is unavailable fleet-wide, and no non-AI cost ledger is present. Until those fields exist, report revenue as $4.92 aggregate commission only, site-attributed revenue as $0, and margin and ROI as unknown.
